Elaine_CS: Heads up — onboarding health check for AceroLabs. Noticed p95 latency spikes and token spend up 41% last 48h. Thinking a low-risk tuning run.
Ravi_SE: Can you paste the model + route details? where is traffic landing today?
Elaine_CS: They're on open-3b v1 via hosted default routing. Errors low but tail latency is hurting UX during spikes.
Marta_ML: Quick thought: try the int8 quantized variant (open-3b-q8) as a canary. Expect ~30% cost drop, modest p95 change. Also consider routing heavy tails to dedicated or a distilled 1.5b for simple prompts.
Ken_AceroOps: We can tolerate small quality tradeoffs for cost wins. What's chance of a visible generation regression?
Marta_ML: Low — we'll run a focused eval on their prompt set. Plan: 5% canary for 24h + rollback if quality regresses >1% on our metrics. Also prefetch KV for repeated prefixes.
Elaine_CS: Proposed rollout: 1) create canary route acero-quant-canary -> open-3b-q8 at 5% 2) fallback to open-3b on error/quality alerts 3) enable prefix caching 4) monitor p95, cost/unit, QA pass rate.
Ravi_SE: I can implement a canary routing policy with auto-rollback hooks. Need their prompt corpus + target KPIs.
Elaine_CS: Dropping sample prompts and dashboard link: https://console.redwood.internal/projects/acero/ops/latency
Ava_CS: Flagging renewal touchpoint next month — if we show ~20%+ cost reduction and stable UX this helps renewal.
Ken_AceroOps: We have release freeze Wed night. Prefer canary Thu 10:00 PST.
Marta_ML: Fine — eval Wed overnight, canary Thu 10:00 PST. Eval spec: 500 prompts, measure BLEU/QA pass/semantic similarity. If delta >2% then manual review.
Ravi_SE: I'll prep route config (weights, health check, fallback). ETA 6h prep for infra changes.
Elaine_CS: Also we'll capture customer feedback in-app and do a quick product call. Ken can you add a "Was this helpful?" ping for responses served by canary?
Ken_AceroOps: Yep, we'll show a small survey and join product call Fri for follow-up.
InfraBot: Canary route created in staging: acero-quant-canary-stg (cr-93421).
Ravi_SE: Pushing to prod Thu 10:00 PST; will post rollout tags and logs to #eng-runtime.
Elaine_CS: Follow-ups: Marta to post eval results by Thu 08:00, Ravi to post rollout status, Ava will prep renewal note.
Marta_ML: Eval results: quality delta 0.7% (within threshold). Latency p50 -28%, cost per token -34%. Submitting canary green.
Ravi_SE: Canary started 10:00 PST. Monitoring p95, errors, quality probes. Auto-rollback enabled if alerts fire.
Ken_AceroOps: Dashboard shows faster responses and lower spend so far. We'll collect user survey results and report.
Ava_CS: Noted for renewal packet.
Elaine_CS: :thumbsup: Good work team. We'll reconvene after 48h canary for final decision and capture CS notes for renewal.
metadata_notes: proactive quant/model swap + routing canary for customer onboarding health; includes links and eval plan
